description: Zerodha equity DELIVERY (CNC) charges on NSE, used for every simulated fill.
notes: VERIFIED on zerodha.com/charges (2026-10-14): zero delivery brokerage; STT 0.1% buy and sell; NSE transaction 0.00307%; SEBI Rs10/crore; GST 18% on (brokerage + SEBI + transaction); stamp 0.015% buy; DP Rs15.34 per scrip when sold (Rs3.50 CDSL + Rs9.50 Zerodha + Rs2.34 GST).

CONSERVATIVE ASSUMPTION: ETFs may attract lower STT (commonly cited 0.001% sell-only for equity ETFs; nil for gold ETFs). Zerodha's page did not confirm ETF-specific rates, so the higher equity-delivery STT is applied. This overstates costs rather than understating them.
UNVERIFIED: NSE IPFT. A page extract read 'Rs0.01 per crore'; that looks like an extraction error, so Rs10/crore (+GST) is used conservatively. Its effect is negligible at this capital size.
STT is rounded to the nearest rupee per fill (contract notes round per trade). Rounding per partial fill is slightly conservative.
